title: Choose Perry's look (round 2)
question: Steered: more professional, more techy, motion on the front page. The roll assigned Live Timing. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Live Timing
options.lineage: Formula 1 live timing screens and timing towers
options.thesis: The three ways into the store race like cars on a timing tower: same track, same task, fastest verified purchase wins.
options.viewport: A clean light shell with the step bar; the hero is a dark timing tower where the agent's laps on each way in tick live, the best result in purple.
options.risk: Motorsport color code must be explained once, or purple and green read as decoration.

raised.raise: Values change in place inside a fixed grid; rows and columns never reflow.
One motion grammar: every move shares one duration and curve.
The step bar shows each step's extent and progress, not just its name.
Every way in carries the same fields in the same places.

options.label: Protocol Trace
options.lineage: network sequence diagrams in protocol specs
options.thesis: Show what the agent actually does: every request between agent, website and catalog drawn as a live sequence diagram.
options.viewport: Three swimlanes (Agent, Website, Catalog); messages animate across them, 7 hops on the website versus 2 with shop commands.
options.risk: Close to how developer docs already look: familiar, and techy readers have seen it.

options.label: Developer Console
options.thesis: A graphite working surface: panels on hairline seams, accents only for state.
options.viewport: Persistent panels: steps on the left, the run in the middle, results on the right.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and techy readers identify with it; loses on clarity for first-time viewers.
options.risk: Near-black dev tool look is the category default.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: boarding pass and live gate board
options.thesis: Results rerank in place like flights on a gate board; a change stays lit until you've seen it.
options.viewport: A pass for the task on top; below, a board ranking the three ways in by cost.
options.case: Holds product clarity: ranking three ways by cost is the result; loses on identity.
options.risk: Travel metaphor needs translating for a shopping product.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Columns never move; only their flaps.
options.case: Fuses poorly: retro instrument, close to a direction already eliminated.
options.kept: Values change in place inside a fixed grid.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful, against the professional steer.

options.label: Software Manual
options.thesis: A stepped tab rail sized by extent.
options.viewport: An open manual at a tab.
options.kept: The step bar shows each step's extent.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked roster with fixed furniture per entry.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cute, against the professional steer.
options.kept: Every way in carries the same fields in the same places.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS dashboard: side navigation, cards and charts, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Side rail with the steps; stat cards and the result chart.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dashboard by design.
